correctness.rationale: All 20 GF4 lines generated by independent slope and determinant constructions; all 190 two-line unions partitioned as 30 parallel and 160 nonparallel. Every support of size 0 through 6 was directly checked by trace masks, the 4- and 5-orbit classifications and affine-semilinear automorphism generators were checked, and independent code reproduces coefficient vectors. A direct six-point geometric obstruction plus shattering heredity proves the zero higher coefficients. Replaying checkers from the package proves that the certificates correspond to the claimed content.

value.rationale: The natural smallest affine field order with five-query shattering for nonparallel two-line unions yields a complete, contrastive P/N/A invariant. Equality of all 1680 parallel-only and nonparallel-only four-faces despite distinct maximal shattering rank, and separation within the same collinearity class by a noncollinear additive four-circuit, provide a mathematically motivated finite calibration and structural boundary for broader affine-plane shattering questions. It is neither a one-off arbitrary subset nor a restatement of the known dimension bounds.
